column6: SVC 柔度矩阵只给出位姿偏导定义："[C] = [ dx / df ]"、"matrix element C(i,j) is the displacement of system degree of freedom i due to a unit force or moment at degree of freedom j"；全 adams_car 手册检索 freez/frozen 0 命中
column7: 固定哪些速度分量、是否含阻尼位姿切线/速度增量，SVC 冻结协议未陈述；唯一相关陈述在 adams_solver/gtcmat.html（速度/加速度扰动项可忽略），但其语义归属 C++ Solver 线性化，不是 SVC 冻结协议

column6: 约束/刚度移除有明确逐项公式：SVCRMV "cmij = cij + cikFk"、"Fk = -ckj/ckk"；SVCRMK "([I] - [C][Kt]) [Cs] = [C]"；车身约束语义有陈述（"necessary to restrain the vehicle body in a full vehicle model"）
column7: 力元/约束的预载几何项是否进入柔度求解未陈述；乘子增量无陈述（preload/multiplier/Lagrange 在 SVC 页面 0 命中）；SVC 路径内活动接触分支的处理未陈述
column9: Adams 兼容的预载/乘子/接触分支等价声称

column6: 动态柔度算法有官方出处（C++ Solver）："When using Adams Solver (C++), GTCMAT computes the compliance matrix as follows: 1. A linearization of the system is performed (the linearization does not change the current state of the system) and a standard input-output representation is obtained ... the term is due to perturbations of the velocities and accelerations of the system at the operating point, therefore it can be neglected. The GTCMAT subroutine can be called during a dynamic or a quasi-static simulation."
column7: 冻结的是何处/何参考系 wrench、广义载荷还是其他量未陈述；陀螺项是否参与未陈述；该项对应代数式在 help 中是图片，未经 OCR 确认
column9: Adams 兼容的动态冻结惯性等价声称；frozen_inertial_load_v1 是本项目定义，不得称为 Adams 等价

column6: 只有局部线性化语义："the characteristics computed by SVC are accurate only at the ride height and steer angle for which they were computed"
column7: 轮胎松弛、衬套历史、摩擦/return-mapping 的 freeze-vs-evolve 协议完全未陈述（friction/return-map/bushing/relaxation 在 SVC 页面 0 命中）

column6: 车身 fixed/free 有明确陈述："A full vehicle model should be supported only by tire forces applied to the spindles or wheels. There must be no other constraints or attachments to ground. If only the front or rear suspension is to be analyzed, the user must fix the body rigidly to ground."；转向 compliance 要求有陈述（pitman arm/rack 相对车身需有柔度）；轮胎范围有陈述（SVCRMK 移除 [Kt]）
column7: 分析中"另一侧轮端"的显式边界条件未陈述（other wheels 0 命中）；载荷反作用路径（reaction path to ground）未陈述
column9: Adams 兼容的整车边界（其他轮端/反作用路径）声称

column6: [C]=[dX/dF]；"Adams Car uses a 12 x 12 matrix relating the motion of the left and right wheel centers to units forces and torques applied to the wheel centers"；索引分组 "i = 1-6 degrees of freedom of marker 1 / i = 7-12 ... marker 2"；"Displacements and forces are calculated in global coordinates"；wheel_rate "Left = 1 / [C(3,3) + C(3,9)]"、"Right = 1 / [C(9,3) + C(9,9)]"；ride rate "Ktotal = Ks Kt / (Ks + Kt)"；roll rate 轮心 "Dz = C(3,3) - C(3,9) - C(9,3) + C(9,9)"、接地点 "Dz = ... + 2 / Kt"、"Rate = T / O = (pi/180) track^2 / Dz"；single bump "Left = 1 / C(3,3)"
